description: This source file is a script for profiling Vitest test runs by generating CPU and heap profiles. It parses command-line arguments, resolves output directories, constructs commands to run Vitest with profiling flags, and executes these commands. It includes utility functions for argument parsing, directory resolution, and command building, and contains a main function that orchestrates the profiling process.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine mode and output directory, handling optional arguments and validation.

methods.name: resolveVitestProfileDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for storing the profiling data, creating a temporary directory if none is specified.

methods.name: buildVitestProfileCommand
methods.description: Builds the command object to execute Vitest with appropriate profiling flags based on the mode.
